Description: "Enhanced receipt printout summary block to display a complete breakdown of Grand Total, Less Pre-Order Advance, and Net Balance Paid (along with its word amount) when printing a settled pre-order."
Instruction: "Update the Grand Total summary row in handlePrint to show a breakdown for pre-orders."
ReplacementContent:
" ${isPreOrder ? `
Grand Total: Rs ${parseFloat(trueGrandTotal).toFixed(2)}
Less Pre-Order Advance: -Rs ${parseFloat(advancePaid).toFixed(2)}
Net Balance Paid: Rs ${parseFloat(remainingBalance).toFixed(2)}
${numberToWords(remainingBalance)} only
` : `
Grand Total: Rs ${parseFloat(order.total_price).toFixed(2)}
${numberToWords(order.total_price)} only
`}"
